name: potato
description: A potato with an irregular oval body and three eyes.
useCase: Identify potatoes in recipes, groceries or ingredient lists.
misuse: Use a visible label when a fruit or vegetable identifies an ingredient, product or dietary choice.

16.reason: Three separated eyes sit inside a broad irregular outline that closes without a short stroke and stays inside the square drawing frame.

24.reason: The larger potato keeps each eye clear of the gently uneven skin. The outline closes at its start without a short connecting stroke.
